issue.title: Restore Bible tab onOpenRecord (unit tap should open Record)
issue.body:
## Summary

Found during the drafting-page audit (#527). After the verse/pericope Bible tab rewrite (#408 / [PR #535](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/535)), `BibleTab` ignores its `onOpenRecord` prop while `DraftingScreen` still passes `onOpenRecord={() => setActiveTab('record')}`.

## Expected

Tapping a verse/unit on the Bible tab selects it **and** opens the Record tab (shell contract from #47).

## Actual

`BibleTab` is declared as `function BibleTab(_props: BibleTabProps = {})` and `handleUnitPress` only calls `setSelectedVerse` / expands pericopes — it never calls `onOpenRecord`.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open a My Work chapter → drafting Bible tab.
2. Tap verse `3` (or any unit card).
3. Unit selects; Record tab does **not** activate.
4. Manually open Record → selected verse is correct.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `BibleTab` consumes `onOpenRecord` from props.
- [ ] `handleUnitPress` invokes `onOpenRecord?.()` after selecting the unit (verse and pericope modes).
- [ ] Unit test covers the callback.
- [ ] Update `.maestro/flows/android/smoke-drafting.yaml` to assert Bible → Record without an extra tab tap once fixed.

## Links

- Audit: #527 / `docs/assessments/drafting-page/`
- Task doc: `docs/assessments/drafting-page/tickets/restore-bible-onOpenRecord.md`
- Historical: #47
- Likely regression from: #408
